sourceUnits.speaker: Priya Shah
sourceUnits.text: I will assess both the pressure protocol and the cybersecurity checklist for applicability to the portable monitor. This is one joint assessment covering both documents.

joint.acceptance: Preserve the explicitly joint applicability assessment of both documents.

sourceUnits.speaker: Priya Shah
sourceUnits.text: I will assess the pressure protocol for applicability to the portable monitor. The cybersecurity checklist is background guidance only; we have not agreed any assessment of it. I will email both documents to Leo.

different_purposes.acceptance: Retain pressure assessment and sending both; do not create a cybersecurity applicability assessment.

sourceUnits.speaker: Priya Shah
sourceUnits.text: We have the installation guide and the test protocol. I will review that. We have not agreed which document that means.

ambiguous_reference.acceptance: Retain the review as uncertain without assigning it to one or both documents as an established fact.

sourceUnits.speaker: Lena Morris
sourceUnits.text: I will send the installation protocol to Omar. Omar, could you assess its applicability?

sourceUnits.speaker: Omar Dean
sourceUnits.text: I am not committing to assess it. We need to agree who can do that.

recipient_not_acceptance.acceptance: Retain Lena sending; do not publish an accepted assessment by Omar.

sourceUnits.speaker: Lena Morris
sourceUnits.text: I will send the installation guide and the risk report if legal approves their release. I will assess the installation guide for assembly requirements only. Sam, please follow up with Jo about review of the risk report.

sourceUnits.speaker: Sam Reed
sourceUnits.text: I will follow up with Jo about reviewing the risk report. Jo has not agreed to do the review; I will ask whether they can.

conditional_separate_work.acceptance: Retain conditional delivery, guide-only assessment and Sam arranging review as separate obligations. Do not assign the assessment to the risk report or guarantee Jo performs it.
